query:
UPDATE review_jobs
                SET
                    status = CASE
                        WHEN status = 'AWAITING_UPLOAD' THEN 'PENDING_PROCESSING'::review_job_status
                        ELSE status
                    END,
                    updated_at = CASE
                        WHEN status = 'AWAITING_UPLOAD' THEN NOW()
                        ELSE updated_at
                    END
                WHERE input_file_path = $1 AND tenant_id = $2
                RETURNING job_id, tenant_id, idempotency_key,
                    status AS "status: ReviewJobStatus", input_file_path AS "input_file_path!", created_at, updated_at,
                    TRUE AS "created!"
